**1\. Excellent coverage**

- Medium-to-full coverage.
- Covers redness, dark spots and acne marks.
- Buildable without necessarily looking cakey.

**2\. Long-lasting**

- Designed to resist sweat, humidity and shine.
- Particularly good for oily skin.
- Holds up well during long days and events.

**3\. Beautiful matte finish**

- Helps blur the appearance of pores.
- Gives a smooth, filtered appearance.
- Doesn't leave a greasy-looking finish.

**4\. Great shade selection**

- 50 shades with different undertones.
- Good options for warm, cool and neutral complexions.

Sources: [www.sephora.com](https://www.sephora.com/product/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-P87985432?icid2=products+grid%3Ap87985432%3Aproduct&skuId=1925320&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[fentybeauty.com](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-100?variant=43441181425709&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.womenshealthmag.com](https://www.womenshealthmag.com/uk/beauty/skin/a61190260/fenty-beauty-pro-filtr-matte-foundation-review/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What reviewers don't like

- Can emphasize dry patches and texture.
- May look too matte on dry or mature skin.
- Some shades can oxidize (look darker after application).
- Requires good skin preparation for the smoothest result.

[www.insiderbeauty.com](https://www.insiderbeauty.com/worth-it/is-fenty-beauty-pro-filtr-soft-matte-foundation-worth-it?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.temptalia.com](https://www.temptalia.com/product/fenty-beauty-pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[theauthored.com](https://theauthored.com/makeup/complexion/fenty-pro-filtr-soft-matte-foundation-review/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Who should use it?

| Skin type | My verdict |
|--------|--------|
| Oily | Excellent |
| Combination | Very good |
| Normal | Good |
| Dry | Use caution |
| Mature | Depends on skin texture |


## Important news about the foundation

(Being discontinued)

Fenty's official website currently says the original Pro Filt'r Soft Matte foundation is retiring to make room for a new formula. Remaining stock is available while supplies last. [fentybeauty.com](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-100?variant=43441181425709&utm_source=chatgpt.com)[fentybeauty.com](https://fentybeauty.com/products/pro-filtr-soft-matte-longwear-foundation-420?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My overall verdict

I'd recommend it if you want\:

- Full coverage without a heavy makeup appearance.
- A soft matte finish.
- Long wear and oil control.
- A foundation that photographs beautifully.

I'd skip it if you prefer dewy, glowy or very moisturizing foundations.

**1\. Excellent coverage**

- Medium-to-full coverage.
- Covers redness, dark spots and acne marks.
- Buildable without necessarily looking cakey.

**2\. Long-lasting**

- Designed to resist sweat, humidity and shine.
- Particularly good for oily skin.
- Holds up well during long days and events.

**3\. Beautiful matte finish**

- Helps blur the appearance of pores.
- Gives a smooth, filtered appearance.
- Doesn't leave a greasy-looking finish.

**4\. Great shade selection**

- 50 shades with different undertones.
- Good options for warm, cool and neutral complexions.

## What reviewers don't like

- Can emphasize dry patches and texture.
- May look too matte on dry or mature skin.
- Some shades can oxidize (look darker after application).
- Requires good skin preparation for the smoothest result.

## My overall verdict

I'd recommend it if you want\:

- Full coverage without a heavy makeup appearance.
- A soft matte finish.
- Long wear and oil control.
- A foundation that photographs beautifully.

I'd skip it if you prefer dewy, glowy or very moisturizing foundations.
